description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source test management project. It handles platform management functionalities such as creating, editing, updating, and deleting platform entries, as well as controlling platform status (enable/disable). The file includes logic for initializing environment, processing user actions, and rendering HTML templates using Smarty.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class representing platform management operations, including error codes for validation and database error handling.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables, security checks, and environment objects for platform management.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes incoming request parameters into an args object for further processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares variables for creating a new platform and sets up the user interface.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares variables and loads existing platform data for editing.

methods.name: do_create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new platform record in the database and prepares success/failure feedback.

methods.name: do_update
methods.description: Processes the update of an existing platform record in the database.

methods.name: do_delete
methods.description: Deletes an existing platform record, including associated data, from the database.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a localized error message based on error code for platform operations.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI object with platform info and user permissions.

methods.name: checkPageAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for platform management page access.
